notes.title: Sir Lovelot - Update 1.21
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thank you sooo much for the support you've given us since launch! Your valuable feedback has helped us understand what to fix, change or improve and make Sir Lovelot a better game.

Time to list all the recent changes :

[list]
[*] Managed to make controls for jumping even more snappy
[*] Added triple checks to all achievements forcing them to unlock properly
[*] Fixed some leaderboards showing players with 0 playtime at the top of the list
[*] Certain effects and background elements are auto-disabled on slower hardware
[*] Some tweaks to a few levels and colliders based on user feedback
[*] Implemented fast reload buttons/keys mostly requested by speedrunners
[*] Many minor fixes and overall performance optimizations
[*] Mapped gamepad controls to more buttons...
[/list]

...which fittingly brings us to the next point. What’s left to do?

[list]
[*] Keyboard & gamepad remapping options. This is proving to be a headache as currently keyboard and gamepad inputs are not separate. This means that remapping the keyboard also overwrites the gamepad and vice-versa. But we’ll get there.
[*] Display missing & hidden collectables in the current level (most likely on the pause screen vs. the HUD, not to spoil the fun for those who wish to go searching without help)
[/list]


That’s about it. Thanks again everyone!
Best wishes and have fun with Sir Lovelot!

notes.title: Super Meat Boy на минималках: Обзор Sir Lovelot
notes.content: Инди-рынок достаточно ловко охватывает почти все возможные жанры, но хороших игр в формате хардкорных платформеров там явно недостаточно. Фактически их можно очень быстро пересчитать по пальцам одной руки. Небольшая студия из Люксембурга замахнулась на жестокий мир Super Meat Boy, предложив его менее хардкорную версию в виде романтической Sir Lovelot.

notes.title: Sir Lovelot can speed-swim
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37463944/1b6dc488a4d61c20313dcbb87ad22b2e4d8fa0c1.png[/img]

We prefer discovery over hand holding tutorials, but this one could easily be overlooked without some guidance. 

When swimming, Sir Lovelot defaults to precision mode, which does what it says on the tin: precise but slooow.

You can speed up things at any time by hitting the dash / speed-swim button.
Try it out!

notes.title: Sir Lovelot 3.3.2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37463944/cea808b8b805cd8d3d3a3c96f5b7fad2b8c8c789.png[/img]

Hey all!

We have a release date! Sir Lovelot is coming out on March 3rd 2021! In just a couple of weeks, you’ll finally be able to run, jump, sprint and slide while chasing damsels on a quest to find the love of your life.

After 2 years of hard work, the big day is approaching fast! We would like to thank everyone who supported us during this time. Your valuable feedback has no doubt helped make Sir Lovelot the game it is today!

In the meantime, enjoy the latest screenshots and animations we've uploaded on the Steam page and hit that 'Add to Wishlist' button if you haven't already! It really helps us out.

Stay safe, take care and have fun!
